_nota: Solo las unidades cuyo mp3 ya esta en el curso. Lo escribe tools/build_songs.py mirando el disco; no editar a mano.

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What colour is it? What colour is it?
[Kids]
Red! Red! The ball is red!

[Leader]
What colour is it? What colour is it?
[Kids]
Yellow! Yellow! The kite is yellow!

[Leader]
What colour is it? What colour is it?
[Kids]
Blue! Blue! The train is blue!

[Leader]
What colour is it? What colour is it?
[Kids]
Green! Green! The car is green!

[All]
Red ball, yellow kite, blue train, green car!
It's my toy box! It's my toy box!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Open the box and look inside,
there's a red ball ready to hide.
A yellow kite, a little blue train,
let's take them out and play again!

[Chorus]
It's a ball! It's a kite!
It's a train! It's a car!
What colour is it? What colour is it?
Tell me what you are!

[Verse 2]
Here's my teddy, soft and brown,
here's my doll in a yellow gown.
Green and red and blue and gold —
more than my two hands can hold!

[Chorus]
It's a ball! It's a kite!
It's a train! It's a car!
What colour is it? What colour is it?
Tell me what you are!

[Bridge — soft]
Who is hiding in the toy box?
A little bird with an orange beak…
Pip! Pip! Hello, Pip!

[Chorus]
It's a ball! It's a kite!
It's a train! It's a car!
What colour is it? What colour is it?
Tell me what you are!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Who is this? Who is this?
[Kids]
This is my mother! This is my mother!

[Leader]
Who is this? Who is this?
[Kids]
This is my father! This is my father!

[Leader]
Who is this? Who is this?
[Kids]
This is my brother! This is my sister!

[Leader]
Who is this? Who is this?
[Kids]
Grandma! Grandpa! And the baby too!

[All]
Mother, father, brother, sister,
grandma, grandpa — this is my family!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Good morning, good morning, the kettle is on,
there's bread on the table and jam in the jar.
An egg in a cup and a spoon by the plate,
a banana for later — we won't go far.

[Chorus]
I have bread, I have jam,
I have milk for breakfast time!
Juice and eggs and a big banana —
morning, morning, we feel fine!

[Verse 2]
Nico drops his spoon again,
Lucía wants the biggest cup.
Rosa cuts the bread in half
and Pip comes in to clean it up!

[Chorus]
I have bread, I have jam,
I have milk for breakfast time!
Juice and eggs and a big banana —
morning, morning, we feel fine!

[Bridge]
What do you have? What do you have?
Say it now before you laugh!

[Chorus]
I have bread, I have jam,
I have milk for breakfast time!
Juice and eggs and a big banana —
morning, morning, we feel fine!

[Verse 1]
There is a sandwich in my lunchbox,
there are two biscuits, brown and round.
There is an apple and a carrot
and a napkin folded down.

[Chorus]
There is, there are —
open up and take a look!
Cheese and water, sweet and tasty,
better than a picture book!

[Verse 2]
Astrid shares her orange carrot,
Nico shares his cheese with me.
Freya pours a cup of water,
lunch is best in company.

[Chorus]
There is, there are —
open up and take a look!
Cheese and water, sweet and tasty,
better than a picture book!

[Bridge]
Share a little, share a lot,
that's the tastiest thing we've got!

[Chorus]
There is, there are —
open up and take a look!
Cheese and water, sweet and tasty,
better than a picture book!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How old are you?
[Kids]
I am seven! I am seven!

[Leader]
How old are you?
[Kids]
I am eight! I am eight years old!

[Leader]
What's on the cake?
[Kids]
Candles! Candles! Count the candles!

[Leader]
And what do we do?
[Kids]
We sing! We wish! We eat the cake!

[All]
Cake and candles, balloons and friends —
a birthday party never ends!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
There's a cake with seven candles
and a balloon on every chair.
There's a present in blue paper
and your best friends everywhere.

[Chorus]
It's your day, it's your day,
how old are you today?
Blow the candles, make a wish
and sing the night away!

[Verse 2]
Nico brought a paper crown,
Astrid brought a puzzle box.
Tomás dropped the lemonade
and Freya laughed till she fell down.

[Chorus]
It's your day, it's your day,
how old are you today?
Blow the candles, make a wish
and sing the night away!

[Bridge]
Close your eyes and make a wish,
open them — the cake's the best!

[Chorus]
It's your day, it's your day,
how old are you today?
Blow the candles, make a wish
and sing the night away!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Hands up!
[Kids]
HANDS UP!

[Leader]
Shake your hands!
[Kids]
Shake, shake, shake!

[Leader]
Nod your head!
[Kids]
Nod, nod, nod!

[Leader]
Wave hello!
[Kids]
Wave, wave, wave!

[Leader]
Stamp your feet and wiggle!
[Kids]
Stamp and wiggle! Stamp and wiggle!

[All]
Shake and nod and raise and wave —
open, close and hands up high!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Raise your hands up to the ceiling,
shake them slowly, shake them fast.
Nod your head and wave to Astrid,
wiggle till the music's past.

[Chorus]
Hands up! Shake! Nod! Wave!
Stamp your feet and touch the floor!
Open, close and open again —
now let's do it once more!

[Verse 2]
Touch your nose and close your fingers,
open wide and count to four.
Stamp the left and stamp the right,
wiggle out and through the door!

[Chorus]
Hands up! Shake! Nod! Wave!
Stamp your feet and touch the floor!
Open, close and open again —
now let's do it once more!

[Bridge]
Slow, slow, slow — and FAST!
Wiggle, wiggle, make it last!

[Chorus]
Hands up! Shake! Nod! Wave!
Stamp your feet and touch the floor!
Open, close and open again —
now let's do it once more!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Can a bird fly?
[Kids]
Yes, it can! High, high, high!

[Leader]
Can a fish swim?
[Kids]
Yes, it can! Fast, fast, fast!

[Leader]
Can a monkey climb?
[Kids]
Yes, it can! Up the tree!

[Leader]
Can a rabbit jump?
[Kids]
Yes, it can! Jump, jump, jump!

[All]
Fly and swim and jump and climb —
animals can, and so can I!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
A bird can fly up very high,
a fish can swim down very deep.
A horse can run across the field
and a cat can find a place to sleep.

[Chorus]
Animals can fly and swim,
animals can jump and run!
Climb and walk and sing and sleep,
fast and high and lots of fun!

[Verse 2]
A monkey climbs from branch to branch,
a puffin walks and looks around.
Pip can sing a funny song
that hardly makes a sound.

[Chorus]
Animals can fly and swim,
animals can jump and run!
Climb and walk and sing and sleep,
fast and high and lots of fun!

[Bridge]
What can you do? What can you do?
Fly? No — but you can run, it's true!

[Chorus]
Animals can fly and swim,
animals can jump and run!
Climb and walk and sing and sleep,
fast and high and lots of fun!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Eleven what?
[Kids]
Eleven birds on the lighthouse wall!

[Leader]
Twelve what?
[Kids]
Twelve small shells beside the sea!

[Leader]
Fifteen what?
[Kids]
Fifteen steps up to the door!

[Leader]
Eighteen what?
[Kids]
Eighteen waves and nineteen more!

[Leader]
And how many candles on the cake?
[Kids]
TWENTY! Twenty! Count them all!

[All]
Thirteen, fourteen, sixteen, seventeen —
up to twenty, that's the game!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Eleven birds are on the wall,
twelve small shells beside the sea.
Thirteen windows in the lighthouse,
fourteen boats for you and me.

[Chorus]
Past ten and counting,
eleven, twelve and more!
Fifteen, sixteen, seventeen —
who's keeping score?

[Verse 2]
Eighteen footprints in the sand,
nineteen feathers, soft and grey.
Twenty candles on the table —
that's a very special day!

[Chorus]
Past ten and counting,
eleven, twelve and more!
Fifteen, sixteen, seventeen —
who's keeping score?

[Bridge]
Start at ten and don't be slow,
add one more and up we go!

[Chorus]
Past ten and counting,
eleven, twelve and more!
Fifteen, sixteen, seventeen —
who's keeping score?

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What is the first letter?
[Kids]
A! A! A is first!

[Leader]
And after A?
[Kids]
B! B! B comes next!

[Leader]
What is the last letter?
[Kids]
Z! Z! Z is last!

[Leader]
Big letter or small letter?
[Kids]
Both! A big A and a small a!

[All]
Twenty-six letters in a row —
that's the alphabet, off we go!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
A is the first and Z is the last,
twenty-six letters, don't say them too fast.
A big letter here and a small letter there,
letters in the water and letters in the air.

[Chorus]
Sing the alphabet, sing it with me,
letter after letter, easy as can be!
First letter, last letter, big one and small —
the alphabet is holding them all!

[Verse 2]
Freya finds an F in the sand,
Nico writes an N with his hand.
Astrid says the letter A
and Tomás sings a T all day.

[Chorus]
Sing the alphabet, sing it with me,
letter after letter, easy as can be!
First letter, last letter, big one and small —
the alphabet is holding them all!

[Bridge]
Point at a letter, say its name,
every single one's a game!

[Chorus]
Sing the alphabet, sing it with me,
letter after letter, easy as can be!
First letter, last letter, big one and small —
the alphabet is holding them all!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How do you spell your name?
[Kids]
Listen! Listen! Letter by letter!

[Leader]
Say it again!
[Kids]
Again! Again! Slowly, slowly!

[Leader]
Is it correct?
[Kids]
Yes! It is correct!

[Leader]
Then what do we say?
[Kids]
Well done! Well done! Well done!

[All]
Spell your name and spell your surname —
letter, letter, write it down!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
How do you spell it? Say it slowly,
letter by letter, one by one.
Listen carefully, write it down
and check it when you're done.

[Chorus]
Spell your name, spell your surname,
say it again, don't be shy!
Listen, write it — is it correct?
Well done, that's how you fly!

[Verse 2]
Astrid spells her name out loud,
Nico writes his on the board.
Freya says it far too fast
and everybody shouts: once more!

[Chorus]
Spell your name, spell your surname,
say it again, don't be shy!
Listen, write it — is it correct?
Well done, that's how you fly!

[Bridge]
Slowly, slowly, letter by letter,
say it twice and it gets better!

[Chorus]
Spell your name, spell your surname,
say it again, don't be shy!
Listen, write it — is it correct?
Well done, that's how you fly!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Nico — he or she?
[Kids]
He! He is a boy!

[Leader]
Freya — he or she?
[Kids]
She! She is a girl!

[Leader]
Our teacher — tall or small?
[Kids]
She is tall! She is tall!

[Leader]
The doctor — is he kind?
[Kids]
Yes! He is kind and he is happy!

[All]
He is, she is, it is —
three small words and that is it!

cancion.titulo: He Is, She Is, It Is
cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
He is a boy with a yellow ball,
she is a girl who is very tall.
It is a puffin with an orange beak
standing on the lighthouse peak.

[Chorus]
He is, she is, it is —
one small word tells you who!
He is happy, she is happy
and it is happy too!

[Verse 2]
She is a teacher, she is kind,
he is a doctor you can find.
It is a morning, warm and blue,
and everybody knows what to do.

[Chorus]
He is, she is, it is —
one small word tells you who!
He is happy, she is happy
and it is happy too!

[Bridge]
Boy or girl or bird or ball —
he, she, it: that's all!

[Chorus]
He is, she is, it is —
one small word tells you who!
He is happy, she is happy
and it is happy too!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What is this?
[Kids]
This is a shell! Here! Here!

[Leader]
What is that?
[Kids]
That is a boat! There! There!

[Leader]
What are these?
[Kids]
These are my shoes! Near, near!

[Leader]
What are those?
[Kids]
Those are the hills! Far, far away!

[All]
This and that and these and those —
here and there, look where it goes!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
This is my hat and that is yours,
this one's near and that one's far.
These are the shells I found this morning,
those are the boats — look where they are!

[Chorus]
This and that, these and those,
here and there, now look and see!
One is "this" and many are "these" —
say it right and follow me!

[Verse 2]
Look at this, it's small and round,
look at that, it's on the ground.
These are near and those are far,
that's the way the small words are.

[Chorus]
This and that, these and those,
here and there, now look and see!
One is "this" and many are "these" —
say it right and follow me!

[Bridge]
Point at something close to you: THIS.
Point at something far away: THAT.

[Chorus]
This and that, these and those,
here and there, now look and see!
One is "this" and many are "these" —
say it right and follow me!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
It's a magic word!
[Kids]
Guess it! Guess it!

[Leader]
Point at the picture!
[Kids]
Point! Point! Point!

[Leader]
Is it right?
[Kids]
Yes! Clap your hands!

[Leader]
Which team wins?
[Kids]
Our team! Our team! We're the winners!

[All]
Word and game and guess and point —
play it once and play again!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Pick a card, don't show it yet,
there's a magic word inside.
Point at something in the picture,
give your team a little guide.

[Chorus]
Guess the word, guess the word,
clap your hands, we play again!
Team by team and one by one,
everybody wins, my friend!

[Verse 2]
Freya guesses "kite" and wins it,
Nico guesses "cat" — so close!
Astrid points and Tomás shouts it,
this is the game we love the most.

[Chorus]
Guess the word, guess the word,
clap your hands, we play again!
Team by team and one by one,
everybody wins, my friend!

[Bridge]
One more word and one more clap,
one more game before we stop!

[Chorus]
Guess the word, guess the word,
clap your hands, we play again!
Team by team and one by one,
everybody wins, my friend!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Where's the party?
[Kids]
At the lighthouse! At the lighthouse!

[Leader]
What do we get?
[Kids]
A certificate! A gold star!

[Leader]
What do we do?
[Kids]
We sing! We dance! Every day!

[Leader]
And how do we feel?
[Kids]
Proud! Proud! Very proud!

[All]
Thank you, friends — hooray, hooray!
The lighthouse party's here today!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The light is on, the door is open,
every friend is coming through.
There's a certificate with your name on it
and a golden star for you.

[Chorus]
Sing and dance, we're at the party,
up the lighthouse, all the way!
Thank you, friends, for every lesson —
hooray, hooray, hooray!

[Verse 2]
On Saturdays we came together,
every day we learned a word.
Freya, Nico, Astrid, Tomás
and the smallest puffin bird.

[Chorus]
Sing and dance, we're at the party,
up the lighthouse, all the way!
Thank you, friends, for every lesson —
hooray, hooray, hooray!

[Bridge]
Look how far you've come — be proud!
Say it once and say it loud!

[Chorus]
Sing and dance, we're at the party,
up the lighthouse, all the way!
Thank you, friends, for every lesson —
hooray, hooray, hooray!
